title: The Commercial Courts Act, 2015.
full_text: The Commercial Courts Act, 2015. null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 4 Enactment Date: 2016-12-31 Act Year: 2016 Short Title: The Commercial Courts Act, 2015. Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of Commercial Courts, Commercial Division and Commercial Appellate Division in the High Courts for adjudicating commercial disputes of specified value and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of LAW AND LEGISLATIVE AFFAIRS Enforcement Date: 23-10-2015 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Law and Justice, Department of Legal Affairs) Location: Chhattisgarh Ref Act ID: 201604 Schedule 1.
